content.name: Bullseye Lantern
entries: A bullseye lantern casts bright light in a 60-foot cone and dim light for an additional 60 feet. Once lit, it burns for 6 hours on a flask (1 pint) of oil.

content.name: Bullseye Lantern
entries: A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 60-foot Cone and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 60 feet.
